description.Name: In vivo 250 um isotropic COSMOS dataset at 7T

latestSnapshot.readme:
This dataset contains an in vivo 250 um isotropic COSMOS QSM dataset acquired at 7T.

Data acquisition was performed at the Athinoula A. Martinos Center for Biomedical Imaging, Massachusetts General Hospital and Harvard Medical School.

The raw BIDS folder contains GRE magnitude images acquired at three head orientations.
The derivatives folder contains orientation-specific R2* maps, a 3-orientation COSMOS susceptibility map, and a brain mask.

Data summary:
- Institution: Athinoula A. Martinos Center for Biomedical Imaging, Massachusetts General Hospital and Harvard Medical School
- Scanner: 7T Siemens Terra X
- Voxel size: 0.25 mm isotropic
- Number of head orientations: 3
- Derivatives: R2* maps, COSMOS susceptibility map, brain mask

Future Updates:
- A fourth head orientation will be added in a future release to improve angular coverage and COSMOS reconstruction quality.
- Raw multi-echo GRE magnitude and phase images will be included in a future release.

metadata.studyDesign: Cross-sectional ultra-high-field MRI study with multiple head orientations for COSMOS reconstruction
